associations.rationale: For an equivariant map on symSub, the theorem gives scalar actions on the scalar and traceless-symmetric summands and explicitly states that every output remains in symSub, directly covering the two moduli and stress symmetry.
For every scalar part x and traceless-symmetric part y in symSub, the type directly gives f(x + y) = Kx + μy, which is the asserted two-parameter Hooke-law formula on decomposed strains.

The type quantifies over every strain in symSub, decomposes it into scalar and traceless-symmetric parts, and gives the two-parameter formula for its image, directly stating the Hooke-law formula on the exact domain.
